recognize_zh: 切片中散布數顆中等大小的巨核細胞，其核小而圓、不分葉或僅輕度分葉（hypolobated），與豐富粉紅色細胞質不成比例，左中方另有一顆核分開的巨核細胞；這些不典型巨核細胞在 GATA2 缺乏合併第 7 號染色體單體的背景下代表發育不良。
features: Several megakaryocytes with round, non-lobated or hypolobated nuclei and moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm (monolobated forms)
A megakaryocyte with separated nuclear lobes (left center) and one with hyperchromatic clumped nucleus (lower right)
Megakaryocytes smaller than normal and scattered singly
Erythroid precursors prominent, with round dense nuclei, admixed with granulocytic precursors
Interspersed adipocytes and hemosiderin granules in this cellular focus
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E, high power) shows a cellular focus with adipocytes in which erythroid precursors are prominent and granulocytic precursors are present. Megakaryocytes are atypical, including small to medium-sized forms with round non-lobated or hypolobated nuclei, a form with separated nuclei, and one with a hyperchromatic nucleus. Blasts are not increased and scattered hemosiderin granules are present. Although this field is focally cellular, the overall marrow is hypocellular for age; megakaryocytic atypia together with monosomy 7 and germline GATA2 mutation is consistent with refractory cytopenia of childhood, GATA2 deficiency-related.

ddx.vs: 5q- MDS also shows monolobated megakaryocytes, but occurs in adults with macrocytic anemia, thrombocytosis and isolated del(5q), not a pediatric patient with monosomy 7.
Aplastic anemia has markedly reduced megakaryocytes without dysplasia, whereas this marrow shows retained, atypical megakaryocytes.

ddx.dx: Reactive megakaryocytic changes (e.g., infection such as MAC)
ddx.vs: Reactive states rarely produce consistent hypolobated and separated-nuclei forms and lack clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.
